card.name: Start of drug names after a split
card.fires_on: The first letter or piece of a drug or medical term that is split in two, such as N in NPH, naloxone, nortriptyline, Nexium, or pon in hyponatremia. It appears in drug lists and warning text.

modes.label: Capital N starting a drug name
modes.description: A lone N begins a drug or brand name, such as NPH, Naloxone, Niacin or NEXIUM.

modes.label: Lowercase n in list of drugs
modes.description: A lone n starts a drug name in a comma-separated list of similar drugs.
